description: This file defines API routes for a Tic Tac Toe game backend using FastAPI. It includes endpoints for creating a game, making a move, retrieving game state, and fetching game history. It interacts with database models representing games, moves, players, and game history, and uses service functions for game logic such as move validation and turn-taking.

methods.name: create_game(req: CreateGameRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Creates a new Tic Tac Toe game, initializing the game state and player sessions.

methods.name: make_game_move( game_id: int, req: MoveRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Processes a player's move, updates game state, checks for a win/draw, and records the move.

methods.name: game_state(game_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Fetches the current state, board, moves, players, and game result of an ongoing or completed game.

methods.name: get_game_history(db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Retrieves a list of completed or archived game histories with results.
